verdict.rationale: Vercel documents running untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, explicitly 'without exposing your production systems.' This architecturally keeps host secrets out of reach of sandboxed code. Per-agent Linux users with private home directories add isolation between agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how credentials and secrets are kept out of or brokered into the sandbox, network egress controls to prevent exfiltration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees.
